description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to allow for customizable logging chains, enabling log messages to be processed and forwarded to other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's Log utility to fit into a chain of LogNode objects, allowing log messages to be forwarded along a linked list of log handlers.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this one.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a given priority, tag, and optional throwable, then forwards the message to the next LogNode in the chain if it exists.
